summary: {member} asks whether the board can learn which designs share an artist while the artists remain anonymous.
realLife: Donald Scarinci asked if members could be told when one artist had submitted both sides without identifying that artist, and Mint counsel agreed to look into it.
inGame: needs: the submission rules and the artists' anonymous entry codes.

turns.pulledBy: Staff can pair the entries without naming anyone.
turns.what: Counsel checks the proposed labeling system.
turns.writesBack: The next packet can carry anonymous pairs.

turns.pulledBy: The pairing would identify a lone entrant.
turns.what: The chair declines to mark paired designs.
